name: Quick Mail
tagline: A full-featured desktop email client — IMAP, POP, calendars and chat, with no account requirements and nothing phoning home.
description: Quick Mail is a complete desktop email client built from the Thunderbird open-source project. Full IMAP/POP/SMTP support, OpenPGP end-to-end encryption, calendars and address books, RSS, and multi-account management — rebranded and configured by QuickOpen with telemetry and data-reporting disabled at build time. It does not report to QuickOpen either.
aiStack: C++/Rust/JS (Thunderbird engine, MPL-2.0), Quick Mail branding + build configuration

engine.note: Built from the Thunderbird open-source project. Not Thunderbird, and neither produced nor endorsed by Mozilla or MZLA Technologies.

platformNotes: Linux first. An email client renders untrusted remote content, so it inherits the same security-cadence rule as Quick Browser: Windows/macOS are not offered until we can rebuild and re-ship on the upstream ESR schedule.
